objective: A frozen exploratory census, exact: for the n x n torus of rule-60 rings with equally spaced law-(12,12) contacts, cut by the contacts h(n-1, j) and v(i, n-1), n = 3 to 48, whether every uncut contact needs every ring (walk counts followed until the next row lies in the span of the earlier ones).
status: Closed: supported 2026-11-08 (exploratory, exact; H1 holds): on the n x n torus of rings cut open by a ring of cuts round it in each direction, every uncut contact needs every ring for every side from 3 to 48 except 8, 16 and 32, where n - 4 contacts each never need the three rings of one corner.
title: Full reach on the cut-open torus, sides 3 to 48
